subject.title: Gateway restart drops queued and in-flight inbound messages

question: Should this issue be owned by the SQLite-backed followup queue recovery PR, a narrower restart-drain mitigation, or a broader gateway/session recovery design?
rationale: Current main does not implement the fix, but multiple open PRs and related issues cover overlapping slices with different storage, compatibility, and channel-delivery tradeoffs.

options.title: Advance SQLite followup recovery
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/82572 or a successor as the canonical fix for queued followups, then track downtime catch-up separately.

options.title: Land a narrow drain mitigation first
options.body: Prioritize the SIGUSR1/debounce mitigation path and leave durable replay for follow-up work.

options.title: Broaden into session recovery
options.body: Fold this issue into the larger gateway/session recovery design if maintainers want one architecture to cover active runs, queues, downtime, and channel ACKs.

recommendation.title: Advance SQLite followup recovery
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/82572 or a successor as the canonical fix for queued followups, then track downtime catch-up separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged restart-drain work makes this the strongest current-history owner for deciding the gateway restart behavior boundary.
